## 自 v0.1.3 以来
- fix(update): scheduled updates get a gentle status-bar reminder, not stolen focus - ci(release): re-sign with stable self-signed cert so TCC grants survive updates - chore(release): bump to 0.1.4; note why scanReportedFocus skips subrole - perf(probe): window enumeration moves off the AX lane to WindowServer reads - feat(probe): cross-validate AX window scan against CGWindowList (stage 1 of B) - fix(reveal): hand-off-induced activations skip the intent/scan chain - fix(app): install a main menu so Cmd+Q works in the settings window - fix(permissions): one grant button for screen recording, same shape as accessibility - fix(update): stop gating update checks behind accessibility permission
## 安装
下载 `Ledge-0.1.4.dmg`,双击打开,把 Ledge 拖到「应用程序」。
**首次打开请右键点图标 →「打开」**,不要双击。这个包是 ad-hoc 签名的,没有 Apple Developer ID 证书(需付费会员),Gatekeeper 会拦一次;选「打开」之后就能正常双击了。
首次启动会请求**辅助功能**权限 —— 移动别的 App 的窗口必须要它。授权后自动就绪, 不需要重启。
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。
装到「应用程序」之后,以后的版本会**在应用内自动下载并安装**,不用再走这一遍。 更新频率在设置里改。
## 校验
``` shasum -a 256 -c Ledge-0.1.4.dmg.sha256 ```

## 自 v0.1.2 以来
- fix(release): drop the lower build when a version appears twice in the appcast - chore(release): bump to 0.1.3 - fix(release): appcast.py must accept legacy .zip entries or the first DMG release dies - docs(plan): the shape-shifting ledger — 39 relaxations this series, 62 repo-wide - refactor(coordinator): lifecycle handlers, audit beat, rescue wiring move to +Lifecycle - chore(coordinator): complete the relaxation markers — 4 missed in batch 1, 2 in +Reveal - refactor(coordinator): reveal intent and focus ownership move to +Reveal - fix(audit): systemSettled loses its default — the settling wire must not degrade silently - refactor(coordinator): hotkey stow/reveal move to +Hotkeys - refactor(coordinator): edge-group derivation stands alone in +EdgeGroups - refactor(coordinator): move drop-semantics into +Drag - docs: SessionCoordinator split design — extension split now, real split with §5 - docs(ci): pin runs-on rationale and itemize what the SDK-parity retirement cost - fix(ci): pin Xcode 26.3 — default 16.4 cannot parse swift-tools 6.2 manifests - docs(spec): record the guided-grant flow and its no-reprompt discipline - feat(permissions): guided screen-recording grant from hover-preview settings - feat(permissions): guided accessibility grant from settings - feat(permissions): PermissionGuide, the single entry for the Codex-style overlay - deps: add PermissionFlow 2.9.0 for the Codex-style permission overlay - feat(release): ship a DMG with drag-to-Applications instead of a bare zip - docs: add PermissionFlow integration design spec (Codex-style permission overlay)

## 自 v0.1.1 以来
- refactor: split SettingsView into one file per tab - feat(update): updates were found but could not install — switch to Sparkle, and release notes finally render - chore: gitignore .claude/worktrees/ to keep nested worktrees out of the index - fix: dedupe mouseLocationAX into ScreenGeometry, remove all observers on shutdown, add push CI - docs: mark the overturned architecture entries in PLAN to stop them misleading the next session - fix(build): Info.plist is a generated artefact and should not be tracked — the repo sat at 0.1.0 while project.yml was already 0.1.1 - feat(log): deliver SPEC §12 — per-session log attribution and categorised AX call metrics with p50/p95 - fix(release): release notes were generated and never used — the release job still ran --generate-notes
